remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Letter from Mr. Oliver B. James. . . . March 5, 1946: "I own . . . 'Iris'. 1929. . . . Oil on canvas, unsigned." Note: Miss O'Keeffe thinks the above is Mr. James' 'Iris.' It might possibly be one of the 'Dark Iris' of the previous year, but in any case it was definitely painted in 1926 or 1927." Dated 1927 on basis of inclusion in 1928 New York (Intimate Gallery–O'Keeffe) exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A green stem extends through the center of this narrow composition. Atop the stem is an iris flower with dark purple lower petals and pale gray center petals. The flower sits against a textured white and gray background.
